project.name: interceptor-spark-4.2_2.13
project.description:
PlanMutatorShim implementation for Spark 4.2.x / Scala 2.13 (WP-20).
This is the ONLY module permitted to import concrete Catalyst case classes (Join, Filter, Aggregate, Window, Project) and pattern-match on them for the Spark 4.2 / Scala 2.13 combination. When a future Spark release changes those signatures, the blast radius is confined to a module like this one.
Spark and Scala versions are overridden here as module-local properties so the 4.2 combination is pinned independently from the reactor default (Spark 3.5.3 / Scala 2.13.8). Spark 4.x is Scala 2.13-only, so this minor line has a single Scala-binary combination; the mutation logic therefore lives directly in this module (no per-minor shared base is warranted for one combination). The canonicalization grammar and the coordinate/MutantID formulas are frozen — the golden cross-version test pins byte-identity with the 3.5 goldens.
NOTE: this module produces a THIN jar (its own classes only). The fat jar that the Python wheel mounts is produced by interceptor-bundle-4.2, which recompiles the version-agnostic api/dispatch/runtime layers against THIS combination's Spark version (the 3.5-built runtime classes cannot link on a 4.2 driver when Catalyst signatures differ).
